english_description: Daniel's World, the same ES II-family game as this collection's yxsj but a distinct build from a different point in the codebase's history — same title, same Taiwan contact email, same bug fingerprints, and the same file structure, yet not a byte-identical repackaging (its combatd.lpc, for instance, differs by roughly 80 lines) — worth keeping as a separate entry rather than treating as a duplicate.
